scope: Nine specified resting-equation claim families; targeted current evidence, exact equation identity and contradictions. No new cohort admission, reanalysis or clinical clearance.
reviewerRole: Maintaining agent; not independent duplicate scientific review

claimReviews.question: Fixed Mifflin arithmetic and its limited empirical evaluation
claimReviews.finding: Published rounded Mifflin arithmetic is established; performance changes across selected populations and protocols. Internal development fit is not external validation.
claimReviews.permittedInterpretation: Educational estimate. No universal accuracy, automatic demographic selector or clinical prescription.
claimReviews.reviewScope: Bounded source-specific equation/provenance and transfer review, not review of every patient, severity, treatment or intersection in these contexts.
claimReviews.reversalTrigger: Preserve the G3 estimate and require an exact-variant independent H4 protocol before a default change.

claimReviews.question: Cunningham arithmetic and body-composition dependence
claimReviews.finding: Metron uses 500 + 22FFM; original 1980 source used estimated LBM/BMR. Several publications label other or unresolved variants Cunningham. BIA repeatability is not reference accuracy.
claimReviews.permittedInterpretation: Explicit optional comparison with body-composition provenance. Never treat DXA lean soft tissue, SMM, historical LBM and FFM as automatically interchangeable.
claimReviews.reviewScope: Bounded source-specific equation/provenance and transfer review, not review of every patient, severity, treatment or intersection in these contexts.
claimReviews.reversalTrigger: H3 must characterize composition provenance and H4 must test exact arithmetic on independently admitted data.

claimReviews.question: G4 retains Mifflin as default and Cunningham as an explicit option pending independent replication.
claimReviews.finding: Evidence includes meaningful Cunningham advantages and disadvantages. G3 and Brandl share a cohort; newer studies do not establish a universally preferred replacement or switching rule.
claimReviews.permittedInterpretation: Retain ADR-0005 as a deployment judgment, not a claim that Mifflin is always more accurate. No production change.
claimReviews.reviewScope: Bounded source-specific equation/provenance and transfer review, not review of every patient, severity, treatment or intersection in these contexts.
claimReviews.reversalTrigger: Relevant independent exact-formula replication, documented input quality, individual errors and prespecified subgroup harm criteria may reverse the choice.

claimReviews.question: G3 reports cohort flow and paired fixed-equation errors in 454 included participants from one released cohort.
claimReviews.finding: Frozen G3 compares paired errors in 454 eligible participants from 459 raw rows; 351 Freising and 103 Nuremberg. Cunningham MAE is lower by 36.2 kcal/day, paired bootstrap 95% CI −49.5 to −22.6.
claimReviews.permittedInterpretation: Single-source external retrospective fixed-equation comparison. Brandl publication is provenance, not independent replication; bootstrap precision does not establish transportability.
claimReviews.reviewScope: Bounded source-specific equation/provenance and transfer review, not review of every patient, severity, treatment or intersection in these contexts.
claimReviews.reversalTrigger: Independent H4 data and separately frozen analysis; retain current published cohort flow and estimates.

claimReviews.question: G3 reports Mifflin-only subgroup metrics and a prespecified age sensitivity analysis.
claimReviews.finding: G3 subgroup table describes Mifflin only. Prespecified age 19–78 sensitivity includes 390, MAE 159.2 kcal/day, 57.4% within ±10%; primary paired sample remains 454.
claimReviews.permittedInterpretation: Do not rank both equations within G3 subgroups from this table, choose an individualized equation, or treat age filtering as the new primary analysis.
claimReviews.reviewScope: Bounded source-specific equation/provenance and transfer review, not review of every patient, severity, treatment or intersection in these contexts.
claimReviews.reversalTrigger: A prespecified paired subgroup comparison with adequate sample size, uncertainty and independent data is required.

claimReviews.question: G4 records ten Haaf 2014 findings in 90 Dutch athletes, including sex-specific Cunningham agreement and Mifflin comparison.
claimReviews.finding: In 90 selected athletes, 500 + 22FFM performed well by sex-specific ±10% accuracy, while the original unrounded Mifflin form performed less well.
claimReviews.permittedInterpretation: Transfer only the exact source result and measurement context; no reanalysis of Metron rounded form or independent validation of newly fitted ten Haaf equations.
claimReviews.reviewScope: Bounded source-specific equation/provenance and transfer review, not review of every patient, severity, treatment or intersection in these contexts.
claimReviews.reversalTrigger: H4 athlete source admission requires independent protocol, rights and measurement checks; published results are already known.

claimReviews.question: G4 records Weijs 2008 results in US and Dutch overweight/obese adult samples with different equation performance.
claimReviews.finding: US Mifflin abstract statistics and different Dutch leaders are relevant; abstract US n=338 conflicts with indexed results n=239. Dutch n=208 is consistent.
claimReviews.permittedInterpretation: Attribute figures to their inspected portion. Do not pick a reconciled US denominator or pool/sample-weight this source. G4 remains a dated abstract-level account.
claimReviews.reviewScope: Bounded source-specific equation/provenance and transfer review, not review of every patient, severity, treatment or intersection in these contexts.
claimReviews.reversalTrigger: Resolve primary full-text/update notice or author clarification before denominator-dependent reuse; no outreach performed.

claimReviews.question: G4 records Tinsley findings from 27 muscular physique athletes and abstract-level equation comparisons.
claimReviews.finding: The 27-person primary abstract supports a possible role for Cunningham (1980) in muscular physique athletes; exact coefficients and detailed errors not inspected.
claimReviews.permittedInterpretation: Small-sample, abstract-level evidence only. Leave-one-out validation of new equations is not external replication.
claimReviews.reviewScope: Bounded source-specific equation/provenance and transfer review, not review of every patient, severity, treatment or intersection in these contexts.
claimReviews.reversalTrigger: Inspect complete equation table, methods and results before exact-variant quantitative synthesis.

claimReviews.question: G4 records Sordi results in 65 cross-training participants as counterevidence to universal Cunningham superiority.
claimReviews.finding: Cross-training sample provides counterevidence to universal 500 + 22FFM superiority; Table 1 labels it 1991. FitMate uses assumed RQ and BIA estimates composition.
claimReviews.permittedInterpretation: No Mifflin comparison was performed. Neither source label nor BIA-generated RMR is an independently measured comparator.
claimReviews.reviewScope: Bounded source-specific equation/provenance and transfer review, not review of every patient, severity, treatment or intersection in these contexts.
claimReviews.reversalTrigger: Independent matched-variant comparison with documented gas measurement, composition and preparation could change the inference.

contradictions.resolution: Attach inspected coefficient fingerprints and mass definitions; quarantine unknown variants from exact-formula performance attribution.
contradictions.unresolved: Source labels and some implementations remain inconsistent or unavailable.

contradictions.resolution: Preserve population, device, prep, variant, endpoint and uncertainty separately. No pooled ranking or automatic equation selector.
contradictions.unresolved: Differences cannot be causally assigned to age, country, training or disease from these studies.

contradictions.resolution: Keep abstract n=338 and indexed tables n=239 side by side; do not rewrite frozen G4 or assume an erratum.
contradictions.unresolved: No reconciled denominator identified; blocks sample weighting.

contradictions.resolution: Count enable once. Source ML and Metron fixed-equation analyses are different questions on overlapping source data.
contradictions.unresolved: No independent Metron H4 replication completed.

contradictions.resolution: Separate mean difference, standard error, ±10% individual agreement and limits of agreement.
contradictions.unresolved: No calibrated individual Metron prediction interval or prospective nutrition response established.

contextQualifiers.generalAdult: Includes source-specific perimenopausal evidence; perimenopause is not silently mapped to pregnancy/lactation. No complete reproductive-state review.
contextQualifiers.olderFrailty: Community-dwelling healthy, AWGS sarcopenia and selected nursing-home residents are distinct populations. Frailty and sarcopenia are not synonyms.
contextQualifiers.pathologicalSpectrum: All broad clinical cells and severity/treatment/intersection dimensions remain unreviewed. Source exclusions do not establish runtime screening or safety.
contextQualifiers.negativeSearch: No absence-of-evidence claim for every disease. Multimorbidity, renal/fluid, thyroid, diabetes, acute illness, pregnancy/lactation, pediatric and other clinical settings require separately scoped evidence.

repositoryEvidence.inspection: Fixed equation functions; protocol source/filter/reference/metric definitions; aggregate cohort flow, paired/bootstrap and Mifflin-only subgroup results; G4 decision and prior audit record. No raw participant data reopened.
repositoryEvidence.g3Reference: COSMED Quark RMR, SECA mBCA 515 composition; released enable data SHA-256 d91d7c609de5b90b7282afc36071c67cdbf8f7362f8d6fae82126f93c8d8ba61

g3Metrics.bootstrap: 5,000 within-site paired resamples, frozen seed 20261106 / Mulberry32 v1; cohort precision, not population transfer
